# v2.1.0b6

## 2026-11-09

This beta repairs the native C300X display dashboard, which did not render in
any earlier 2.1.0 beta. It includes the previous 2.1.0 beta features and fixes.
The stable release remains **2.0.0**.

The device agent is unchanged and stays at **2.1.0b5**. Only display files
changed, and those travel in the agent bundle, so the verified binary is kept
rather than relabelled.

## Native Display

- The dashboard is visible again. Since 2.1.0b1 the page showed a single line
  and a green "board loaded" status while badges, weather, energy flow, tiles
  and the pager stayed hidden. The container was gated on an identity
  comparison against `null`, which QtQuick 1.1 cannot store in a `variant`
  property, so the gate never matched. Gating now runs through an explicit
  boolean.
- Detail controls handle a value the device does not report. The number slider
  no longer starts at an undefined position, and a switch whose state is
  unknown shows "?" with an unknown-state indicator instead of an off-looking
  box.
- The alarm quick-action tile is as wide as the panel below it instead of
  ending short by the width of the hidden keypad.

## Update

1. In Marketplace or HACS, open the integration menu, choose **Redownload**,
   enable prerelease or beta versions and select **2.1.0b6**.
2. Restart Home Assistant.
3. Complete the agent-update Repair. It installs the updated bundle; the agent
   binary itself is unchanged, so no new agent version is reported.
4. Reapply the **Display patch**, including when upgrading from an earlier
   beta. Applying it restarts the device GUI.

The display fix is derived from the QtQuick property semantics and is covered by
a source contract test; local tests do not execute the device's Qt runtime, so
confirm the dashboard on the actual C300X. Physical display behavior and Ring
Call interruption remain beta checks.

See [beta and update guidance](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-bticino-c300x/blob/v2.1.0b6/docs/advanced-maintenance.md#beta-versions)
and [display controls](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-bticino-c300x/blob/v2.1.0b6/docs/feature-reference.md#display-device-controls).
